title: Beacon alerts file
description: A JSON (or YAML with the same keys) file the github `file` and `gist` modes read. The same shape the local collection produces.

id.description: Stable across edits. Dismissals are keyed by id and content, so keep it and change the content.

title.description: Plain text. Rendered as text, never as HTML.

body.description: HTML. Sanitized on fetch: paragraphs, inline formatting, links and lists survive.

markdown.description: Used when body is absent. Rendered with raw HTML stripped, then sanitized.

teaser.description: HTML. When present the banner shows this and links to url with a Read more link.

audiences.description: Exact audience names. Empty or absent means every site.

url.description: http or https. Anything else becomes #.

dismissible.description: Defaults to true, and to false for emergency.
